description: Affluent consumers with demonstrated interest in technology products and services
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN DATA d ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
JOIN BEHAVIORS b ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = b.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE d.INCOME_RANGE >= 100000
AND b.CATEGORY IN ('Technology', 'Electronics', 'Gaming')
AND p.EMAIL IS NOT NULL

description: Mobile-engaged millennials aged 25-40 with active smartphone usage
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT m.HOUSEHOLD_ID, m.ADDRESS_ID
FROM MAIDS m
JOIN DATA d ON m.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE d.AGE BETWEEN 25 AND 40
AND m.LASTSEENDATE >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE())
AND m.DEVICE_TYPE = 'Mobile'

description: High-quality email addresses with verified domains and recent engagement
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT e.HOUSEHOLD_ID, e.ADDRESS_ID, e.EMAIL
FROM EMAIL e
JOIN DATA d ON e.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE e.EMAILQUALITYLEVEL >= 8
AND e.DOMAIN NOT IN ('gmail.com', 'yahoo.com', 'hotmail.com')
AND e.LASTSEENDATE >= DATEADD(month, -6, GETDATE())

description: Homeowning families in suburban areas with children
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN DATA d ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE d.HOME_OWNER = 1
AND d.DWELLING_TYPE = 'Single Family'
AND d.PRESENCE_OF_CHILDREN = 1
AND d.URBAN_DENSITY = 'Suburban'

description: High-income consumers showing purchase intent for luxury vehicles
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN DATA d ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
JOIN BEHAVIORS b ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = b.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE d.INCOME_RANGE >= 150000
AND b.CATEGORY = 'Automotive'
AND b.SUBCATEGORY IN ('Luxury', 'Premium')
AND b.INTENT_SCORE >= 75

description: Contactable phone numbers not on Do Not Call registry with recent activity
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT ph.HOUSEHOLD_ID, ph.ADDRESS_ID, ph.PHONE
FROM PHONE ph
JOIN DATA d ON ph.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE ph.DNC = 0
AND ph.PHONEQUALITYLEVEL >= 7
AND ph.PHONETYPE IN (1, 3)
AND ph.LASTSEENDATE >= DATEADD(month, -3, GETDATE())

description: Consumers actively engaged with health, fitness, and wellness content
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN BEHAVIORS b ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = b.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE b.CATEGORY IN ('Health', 'Fitness', 'Wellness', 'Nutrition')
AND b.FREQUENCY >= 5
AND b.RECENCY <= 30

description: Frequent online shoppers with high transaction volume
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN BEHAVIORS b ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = b.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE b.CATEGORY = 'E-Commerce'
AND b.TRANSACTION_COUNT >= 10
AND b.LAST_PURCHASE_DATE >= DATEADD(month, -2, GETDATE())
AND b.TOTAL_SPEND >= 500

description: 18-24 year olds with high digital engagement across multiple platforms
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN DATA d ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
JOIN MAIDS m ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = m.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE d.AGE BETWEEN 18 AND 24
AND m.APP_USAGE_HOURS >= 20
AND p.EMAIL IS NOT NULL

description: B2B professionals in decision-making roles at mid to large companies
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID, e.EMAIL
FROM PII p
JOIN DATA d ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
JOIN EMAIL e ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = e.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE d.OCCUPATION IN ('Executive', 'Manager', 'Director')
AND d.COMPANY_SIZE >= 100
AND e.DOMAIN NOT IN ('gmail.com', 'yahoo.com', 'hotmail.com', 'outlook.com')

description: Affluent consumers with frequent travel behavior and premium booking patterns
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN DATA d ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
JOIN BEHAVIORS b ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = b.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE d.INCOME_RANGE >= 100000
AND b.CATEGORY IN ('Travel', 'Hotels', 'Airlines')
AND b.PREMIUM_BOOKING = 1
AND b.FREQUENCY >= 4

description: Tech-forward consumers with smart home device ownership and IoT engagement
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN BEHAVIORS b ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = b.HOUSEHOLD_ID
JOIN IP i ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = i.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE b.CATEGORY IN ('Smart Home', 'IoT', 'Home Automation')
AND i.CONNECTED_DEVICES >= 5
AND b.RECENCY <= 60

description: Consumers showing interest in financial products and investment services
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN DATA d ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
JOIN BEHAVIORS b ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = b.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE d.INCOME_RANGE >= 75000
AND b.CATEGORY IN ('Finance', 'Investment', 'Banking')
AND b.INTENT_SCORE >= 60
AND d.AGE >= 30

description: Active subscribers to multiple streaming services with high engagement
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN BEHAVIORS b ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = b.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE b.CATEGORY = 'Streaming'
AND b.SUBSCRIPTION_COUNT >= 3
AND b.MONTHLY_HOURS >= 40
AND b.CHURN_RISK < 30

description: Environmentally conscious consumers with green purchasing behavior
sqlQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT p.HOUSEHOLD_ID, p.ADDRESS_ID
FROM PII p
JOIN BEHAVIORS b ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = b.HOUSEHOLD_ID
JOIN DATA d ON p.HOUSEHOLD_ID = d.HOUSEHOLD_ID
WHERE b.CATEGORY IN ('Sustainable Products', 'Eco-Friendly', 'Renewable Energy')
AND b.GREEN_PURCHASE_INDEX >= 70
AND d.EDUCATION_LEVEL IN ('College Graduate', 'Post Graduate')
